description: This file defines a ToastService class used for displaying toast notifications in a Blazor application. It includes methods to show and hide toasts, manage countdown timers, and trigger events for UI updates.

classes.name: ToastService
classes.description: A service class for managing toast notifications, including display and timing logic.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Triggers the display of a toast message with a specified level and starts countdown timer.

methods.name: StartCountdown
methods.description: Initializes and restarts the countdown timer for hiding the toast.

methods.name: SetCountdown
methods.description: Creates and configures the Timer object if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: HideToast
methods.description: Event handler called when the countdown elapses to trigger hiding the toast.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the Timer resource when the service is no longer needed.
